# BlazePhoenix SDK

> `@blazephoenix/sdk` is the official TypeScript SDK (MIT) for BlazePhoenix, the on-chain DEX aggregator on Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain. It quotes, builds, verifies and executes swaps with every read made as an `eth_call` from your process to the RPC node you configure, against the same Quoter contract that settles the swap.

The SDK is free and needs no API key and no signup. You bring the RPC node: the package ships no RPC endpoints (a test enforces it), and a chain without a configured node throws `rpc_required` instead of falling back to someone else's infrastructure. Each node's `eth_chainId` is checked once (`rpc_chain_mismatch`). URLs are reduced to their host in every error and in its `cause` chain, because keys live in them. The SDK never asks for, stores or touches a private key: `execute` takes a viem `WalletClient` you control.

The only request to blazephoenix.xyz is the deployment registry (`GET /api/deployments`), which tells the SDK about new protocol versions. Pinned addresses cannot be moved remotely, every remote-sourced set is verified on your RPC before first use, and `registry: { mode: 'embedded' }` turns the fetch off.

Install:

```bash
npm i @blazephoenix/sdk viem
```

Configure the RPC in code or from the environment:

```ts
import { BlazePhoenix } from '@blazephoenix/sdk';
const blaze = new BlazePhoenix({ rpc: { base: process.env.BASE_RPC_URL } });
const q = await blaze.quote({ chain: 'base', tokenIn: 'WETH', tokenOut: 'USDC', amount: '1.5' });
```

`rpc` accepts a URL, a fallback list, an EIP-1193 provider, a viem Transport or a per-chain map. With no `rpc`, the client reads `BLAZEPHOENIX_RPC_URL` (one node) or `BLAZEPHOENIX_RPC_BASE`, `_ETHEREUM`, `_OPTIMISM`, `_ARBITRUM`, `_ROBINHOOD` (comma-separated for fallback).

Main methods: `quote`, `quoteExact`, `quoteBatch`, `buildSwap` (verified Router calldata), `simulate`, `execute`, `getFills`, `watchFills`, `tokenInfo`, `solvency`, `deployments`. Every failure is a `BlazeError` with a stable `code`.

- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/SDK/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/SDK/main/SECURITY.md): scope and how to report a vulnerability

## Examples

- [quote.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/SDK/main/examples/quote.ts): a single quote on your node
- [watch-fills.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/SDK/main/examples/watch-fills.ts): follow `Swap` events live
- [phoenix-bot.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/SDK/main/examples/phoenix-bot.ts): a zero-custody Telegram bot on your own nodes
